text: Acadomia's legal notice names DOMIA GROUP SA (RCS Paris 349 367 557) as the site's publisher and says AIS 2 SAS – ACADOMIA is a subsidiary of DOMIA GROUP SA. Metric Capital Partners' portfolio lists Acadomia as a Fund I investment from 2013, with status Exited.
short: Acadomia is a brand of Domia Group; Metric Capital Partners' Fund I held the company (exited).
